documents.title: Corporate Action Book Closure From Friday July 31,2026 To Thursday August 06,2026
Corporate Action: Record Date For Payment Of Dividend 2025-26
Compliance-57 (5) : intimation after the end of quarter

analysis.summary: Crestchem Limited reported a total income of Rs. 25.52 Crores and a net profit of Rs. 2.71 Crores for the financial year 2025-26. The company declared a final dividend of 15% and remains entirely debt-free. To drive long-term growth, Crestchem incorporated Oleo Biosciences Private Limited as a subsidiary to set up a Medium Chain Triglyceride (MCT) Oil manufacturing facility in Bengaluru.

guidance.claim: Commercial production of the MCT Oil project is expected to begin in the fourth quarter of the Financial Year 2026-27.
guidance.quote: Subject to successful completion of installation, commissioning and statutory approvals, commercial production is expected to commence during the fourth quarter of the Financial Year 2026-27.

guidance.claim: Crestchem is hopeful for a pilot plant during FY 2025-26 or thereafter.
guidance.quote: Company is hopeful for pilot plant during FY 2025-26 or thereafter.

guidance.claim: Management believes the company's financial position will improve considerably in coming years.
guidance.quote: The company is committed to build the business operations within budget and considering that the business operates on a going concern basis, it is believed that financial position of the company will improve very considerably in the coming years, going by the recent last few years improvement in performances as well.

demand_outlook.claim: The global and Indian MCT market is experiencing healthy growth due to rising consumer awareness of preventive healthcare, ketogenic diets, sports nutrition, and functional foods.
demand_outlook.quote: The global and Indian MCT market continues to witness healthy growth due to increasing consumer awareness regarding preventive healthcare, ketogenic diets, sports nutrition and functional foods.

demand_outlook.claim: Global demand for MCT Oil is rising, driven by health consciousness, clinical and functional nutrition, and premium specialty ingredients.
demand_outlook.quote: The global demand for MCT Oil continues to grow, driven by increasing health consciousness, expanding applications in clinical and functional nutrition, and rising demand for premium specialty ingredients.

demand_outlook.claim: Price volatilities continued during the year under review.
demand_outlook.quote: The Price volatilities is remains continued during the year under review.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that predicting market demand trends is difficult due to ongoing global economic conditions.
demand_outlook.quote: Management is reasonably optimistic however, it is difficult to predict the market demand and its trend, due to critical economic conditions created by disturbances due to Covid -19, Ukraine war etc.

demand_outlook.claim: Specialty chemicals presents growth opportunities in which the company operates.
demand_outlook.quote: Opportunities are already there in the field of specialty chemicals, which is a growing field, in which the company operates.

capex_expansion.claim: The company incorporated Oleo Biosciences Private Limited as a subsidiary to set up a manufacturing facility for Medium Chain Triglyceride Oil.
capex_expansion.quote: As part of its long-term growth strategy, the Company incorporated Oleo Biosciences Private Limited, Bengaluru, as its subsidiary with an equity participation of 75% for setting up a manufacturing facility for Medium Chain Triglyceride (MCT) Oil, a high-value specialty product catering to pharmaceutical, nutraceutical, food and personal care industries.

capex_expansion.claim: Procurement and installation of plant, machinery, utilities, and other equipment for the project are currently underway.
capex_expansion.quote: The procurement and installation of plant and machinery, utilities and other equipment for the project are presently in progress.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is actively planning to expand and invest in new or startup businesses in limited liability partnership firms within the specialty chemicals and related fields.
capex_expansion.quote: As was reported in previous financial year’s Annual Report the Company is now actively planning to expand and invest in new/start up business in limited liability partnership (LLP) firms, within our Speciallity Chemicals and related fields of operations.

capex_expansion.claim: A requisite pilot plant facility for new products is likely to be established by the company at the LLP firms in due course.
capex_expansion.quote: Accordingly, requisite pilot plant facility, for such products, is likely to be established by our company at such LLP firms, in due Course.

capex_expansion.claim: Crestchem plans to invest in new or startup limited liability partnership firms in the chemical field.
capex_expansion.quote: The Company is planning to invest in new/start up business- limited liability partnership firm(s), within our overall chemical and related field of operations.

capex_expansion.claim: The company assigned project work to a CSIR entity during the year under review.
capex_expansion.quote: During the year under review company has assigned the Project Work to one of the entites of CSIR.

margins_costs.claim: The company faces threats from volatility in the prices of coconut oil and palm kernel oil.
margins_costs.quote: Volatility in prices of coconut oil and palm kernel oil.

margins_costs.claim: Supply chain disruptions and freight cost fluctuations pose threats to the company.
margins_costs.quote: Supply chain disruptions and freight cost fluctuations.

margins_costs.claim: Price volatilities continued during the year under review.
margins_costs.quote: The Price volatilities is remains continued during the year under review.

margins_costs.claim: The company managed raw material procurement from time to time and increased sales turnover.
margins_costs.quote: Your company managed to procure raw materials from time to time and has also improved sales turnover during the year under review.

margins_costs.claim: Substantial operational improvements in FY 2023-24 led to improved bottom-line performance.
margins_costs.quote: The operations of the company are improved substantially for the year 2023-24, resulting into the improvisation in the bottom-line figures.

margins_costs.claim: Management's focus on turnover improvement resulted in improved profitability.
margins_costs.quote: The Company has focused to improve the turnover and ultimately it resulted to improve the profitability of the Company.

capital_allocation.claim: The company is debt-free and has no borrowings from any bank or institution.
capital_allocation.quote: The company has no borrowings from any Bank or any Institution.

capital_allocation.claim: The company declared a 15% dividend for the financial year 2025-26.
capital_allocation.quote: Your directors pleased to inform that Company has declared 15%Dividend for the year 2025-26 (Subject to TDS as per Income tax Act) subject to approval of members at ensuing Annual General Meeting.

capital_allocation.claim: The company plans to invest, give loans, or provide guarantees up to Rs. 2.75 Crores in its subsidiary.
capital_allocation.quote: RESOLVED THAT pursuant to Section 186(3) and other applicable provisions of the Companies Act, 2013, consent of members be and is hereby accorded to the Board to invest, give loans or guarantees up to an aggregate amount of Rs.2.75 Crores proposed investment in subsidiary, notwithstanding that the same limits within the permissible limits under Section 186.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board of Directors recommended a final dividend of 10% or Rs 1 per equity share of Rs 10 each for the financial year ended March 31, 2025.
capital_allocation.quote: To declare a final dividend of Rs 1/- (10%) per equity share of Rs. 10/- each, for the financial year ended March 31,2025

capital_allocation.claim: The board declared a maiden 5% dividend for FY 2023-24 subject to shareholder approval.
capital_allocation.quote: Your directors pleased to inform that Company has declared 5% Maiden Dividend for the year 2023-24 (Subject to TDS as per Income tax Act) subject to approval of members at ensuing Annual General Meeting.

risks_headwinds.claim: The company is monitoring project execution risks such as procurement timelines, installation schedules, utility availability, regulatory approvals, cost escalations, and market conditions.
risks_headwinds.quote: As the project is currently under implementation, the Company continues to monitor project execution risks, including procurement timelines, installation and commissioning schedules, availability of utilities, regulatory approvals, cost escalations and market conditions.

risks_headwinds.claim: The company has a pending income tax demand of Rs. 2,06,000 for a prior period.
risks_headwinds.quote: During the year under review, the Company has received the notice from I one income tax demand of Rs. 2,06,000/- for prior period is yet pending though as per our company the same is not required to be paid for which we have already submitted our clarification to the income tax department.

risks_headwinds.claim: The company faces threats from exchange rate fluctuations affecting export competitiveness.
risks_headwinds.quote: Exchange rate fluctuations affecting export competitiveness.

risks_headwinds.claim: Disturbances from international events like Covid-19 and the Ukraine war affected the company, with prolonged ill effects and supply chain disruptions continuing.
risks_headwinds.quote: Disturbances due to International event like Covid-19, Ukraine war etc. are being faced by the company. The prolonged ill effects including disturbances in the supply chain and such other disturbances continued till the date of this report.

risks_headwinds.claim: The company received an income tax demand notice of Rs 2,06,000 for a prior period which is still pending.
risks_headwinds.quote: During the year under review, the Company has received the notice from income tax demand of Rs. 2,06000/- for prior period is yet pending though as per our company the same is not required to be paid for which we have already submitted our clarification to the income tax department.

risks_headwinds.claim: Disturbances from international events like Covid-19 and the Ukraine war continue to affect the company.
risks_headwinds.quote: Disturbances due to International event like Covid-19, Ukraine war etc. are being faced by the company.

risks_headwinds.claim: The company faces ongoing threats from growing competition in its industry.
risks_headwinds.quote: Threats in terms of growing competition remains as usual in every field of business.

risks_headwinds.claim: Macroeconomic uncertainties remain a concern that the company is actively monitoring.
risks_headwinds.quote: Concerns due to the ongoing uncertain macro economic situation, remains, but Company, is maintaining keen vigil over the ever-changing situation and quickly adapt remedial actions.

management_commitments.quote: Subject to successful completion of installation, commissioning and statutory approvals, commercial production is expected to commence during the fourth quarter of the Financial Year 2026-27.

management_commitments.claim: The company proposes to make investments, grant loans, or provide guarantees in its subsidiary for capital expenditure and business expansion.
management_commitments.quote: The Company proposes to make investment(s), grant loan(s), provide guarantee(s), security(ies) and/or make acquisition(s) in one or more tranches in its subsidiary company namely OLEO BIOSCIENCES PRIVATE LIMITED for meeting capital expenditure, working capital requirements, purchase of plant & machineries, business expansion and other general corporate purposes.

management_commitments.claim: Smt. Rinkal Maulik Jasani was appointed as an Independent and Non-Executive Woman Director for a term of five consecutive years commencing from August 21, 2025 to August 20, 2030.
management_commitments.quote: to hold office for a term of 5 (five) consecutive years commencing from 21-08-2025 to 20-08-2030 (both days inclusive).
